about_the_game:
Good old pixel art RPG with the theme of "RPG that is more interesting than nostalgia"
Complete version of the free version of Complex Hero released in 2017


Story
A paranormal phenomenon that affects reality from thoughts...
Research has been conducted for over half a century at the research facilities of the Novara Empire.

Depair has been studied as an almighty power to save humanity,
Eventually, it came to be used as a tool of war.

2135...
caused the highest number of casualties in the history of the Empire.
During the conflict between the Empire and the anti-Imperial force Bantarei,
An experimental subject with the most outstanding power of depair was thrown into the war,
Due to incomplete control, it went out of control and the city of Bantarei disappeared.

The empire that won the conflict
Obtain the territory of Bantarei,
All experimental subjects with the power of Depair were sealed away as risk factors.

Approximately 15 years have passed,
Information on Depair's research, which the Empire had been secretly continuing, has been leaked by someone.
From the tragic experience brought about by Depair,
Resistance grew stronger from anti-Imperial organizations that saw this power as dangerous.

2150 years...
As conflicts in various places become more intense again, the anti-imperial organization Nilgor,
He released an experimental subject that was said to have caused the city to disappear.


Features of this game
・Graphics featuring 2D pixel art
・Dystopian near-future worldview
・Deep SF story development
・The number of attacks changes depending on the speed (SPD) value of enemy and ally characters! A flowing battle!
・Offense and defense that makes full use of (ATK) (DEF) values related to physical attacks and (IMG) values related to psychokinetic attacks!
・Unique skills possessed by each character that are released by consuming life force (LP)!
- Vigorous and intense battles using the Guts Point (GP) system, which allows you to withstand the consumption of vitality by the skills you use and the powerful attacks from the enemy!
- Up to 10 ally characters can participate in the battle using the replacement system during battle!
・A character's growth status value changes depending on their actions during battle. In addition, you can freely develop your character with mode settings that allow you to choose status characteristics and which status to prioritize for growth!
